import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Clean data - remove empty strings and handle NaN values
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Remove leading/trailing quotes and whitespace
    text = str(text).strip('"').strip()
    # Remove any markdown formatting
    text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")
    return text


train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Split for validation (hold out 20% for evaluation, NEVER use on training)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["Comment"],
    train_df["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Create features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=2000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=1
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"])

# Choose best model based on quick validation scoring
best_auc = 0
best_model = None

# Compare different models quickly
models = [
    (
        "RF",
        RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=200, max_depth=10, class_weight="balanced", random_state=42
        ),
    ),
    ("LR", LogisticRegression(max_iter=500, class_weight="balanced")),
    ("XGB", XGBClassifier(use_label_encoder=False, eval_metric="auc", random_state=42)),
]

for name, model in models:
    val_pred = model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train).predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    try:
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
        print(f"{name} AUC on validation: {auc:.4f}")
        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_model = model
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{name} error: {e}")

print(f"\nBest model: {best_model.__class__.__name__}")

# Train final model
final_model = best_model.copy()
final_model.fit(vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train), y_train)
y_pred_prob = final_model.predict_proba(vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"]))[:, 1]

# Save submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Predicted": y_pred_prob})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Final validation score on hold-out set
final_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, final_model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1])
print(f"\nFinal Hold-Out Validation AUC: {final_auc:.4f}")
